package diagnosticfixture

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestLoadDefinitionHasFixedDiagnosticAssessmentContract(t *testing.T) {
	definition, err := LoadDefinition()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if definition.FixtureID != "diagnostic_assessment_smoke" || definition.FixtureVersion != 1 || definition.Slug != "diagnostic-assessment-smoke-v1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected identity: %#v", definition)
	}
	if len(definition.Tasks) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("tasks = %d, want 3", len(definition.Tasks))
	}
	for index, item := range definition.Tasks {
		if item.Type != "test" || item.AssessmentPurpose != "diagnostic" || item.ExecutionMode != "NO_RUN" || item.EvaluationMode != "AUTO" || item.UIMode != "QUIZ" || item.SubmissionMode != "ANSWER_PAYLOAD" {
			t.Fatalf("task %d has unexpected diagnostic contract: %#v", index, item)
		}
		if item.RequiresSandbox || item.ExposesPreview || item.ExposesTerminal || item.SupportsLiveValidation {
			t.Fatalf("task %d has runtime capability enabled", index)
		}
		if len(item.LearningTargets) != 1 || len(item.Tests) != 1 || len(item.Tests[0].Variants) != 3 {
			t.Fatalf("task %d does not have the required target/question/variant graph", index)
		}
		correct := 0
		for _, variant := range item.Tests[0].Variants {
			if variant.IsCorrect {
				correct++
			}
		}
		if correct != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("task %d correct variants = %d, want 1", index, correct)
		}
	}
}

func TestResultJSONNeverHasAssessmentAnswerFields(t *testing.T) {
	result := Result{
		Schema: "course-diagnostic-assessment-fixture-result.v1",
		Status: "created",
		Assessments: []AssessmentMetadata{{
			ID: "task-id", LessonID: "lesson-id", Type: 11,
			AssessmentPurpose: "diagnostic", EvaluationMode: "AUTO", Order: 1, Version: 1,
		}},
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"is_correct", "correct_order", "question", "variant", "answer", "source_key"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(raw), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("safe fixture result includes forbidden field %q: %s", forbidden, raw)
		}
	}
}
